title: 易混动词辨析

examples.en: I borrowed a book from the library.
examples.zh: 我从图书馆借了一本书。

examples.en: Can you lend me your pen?
You can keep it for two weeks.

guess.question: 想问“我能借你的字典吗”，该用哪一个？

options.text: borrow——往自己这边借，说 borrow sth from sb
options.feedback: 对！borrow 是借入（from），lend 是借出（to），方向正好相反。
不对——lend 是“借给别人”，你要用别人的字典，是借入。
不对——keep 说的是“能借多久”，不能表示“借来”这个动作。

rule.rule: say + 说的内容 / speak + 语言 / tell + 人 / talk + with·to；borrow 借入（from）/ lend 借出（to）/ keep 保留（接时间段）；bring 带来 / take 带走 / carry 搬运 / fetch 去取来
rule.formula: ① speak English（说某种语言）　say it in English（说内容）　tell sb sth　talk with sb about sth　② borrow sth from sb　lend sb sth = lend sth to sb　keep sth for + 时间段　③ bring here / take there / carry 搬运 / fetch 去拿来

anchors.en: I borrowed a dictionary from Tom.
anchors.zh: 我从汤姆那儿借了本词典。

anchors.en: How long can I keep the book?

trap.why: 你要用别人的东西是借入，用 borrow；lend 是“借给别人”。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——borrow 借进来、lend 借出去、keep 借多久，方向别搞反。

check.stem: — Can I ____ your bike? — Sure, but you can only ____ it for two hours.

options.distractor: 第二空接时间段 for two hours，用 keep

check.explanation: 借入用 borrow；接时间段用 keep。

check.stem: Please ____ it in English. We don't understand Chinese.

options.distractor: speak 后面接语言，不接 it
talk 是不及物动词，不接 it

check.explanation: “用英语说它” → say it in English。

options.text: My father told me an interesting story.
My father said me an interesting story.
My father told an interesting story me.
My father said an interesting story me.

check.explanation: tell sb sth：tell me a story。
